title: pipeline-drift declaration
description: Maps each Jenkins job to the local working copy of the repository it reads. The branch, the commit and the script path are not declared here - they are read from the live job, because declaring them would mean asserting the very thing this module exists to verify.

workingCopyRoot.description: Directory holding the clones, relative to the repository root or absolute.

key.description: Stable short name used in reports.

jobPath.description: Display path of the Jenkins job, folder segments separated by /.

remoteName.description: Git remote to query. Defaults to origin.
